articles.summary: Real-world data from 76,138 patients shows anxiety and depression severity doesn't predict response to gut-directed hypnotherapy for IBS, even in severe cases.
articles.title: Anxiety severity doesn't reduce hypnotherapy response in IBS

articles.summary: New real-world data show how anxiety, depression, food-related triggers and age affect engagement and outcomes with gut-directed hypnotherapy for IBS.
articles.title: Gut-directed hypnotherapy for IBS: Who benefits?
